cases.prompt: No web lookups please, just your knowledge and skills. I'm building a custom Collector with OCB to match collector-contrib v0.163.0. The manifest needs the otlp receiver, the k8sattributes and tail_sampling processors, the otlp exporter, and the file and env config providers. Which OCB version and which exact module versions go in builder.yaml, and can I download a prebuilt ocb binary for that release? Also, is k8sattributes stable?
expectations: Uses OCB v0.163.0 and pins the core components and tailsamplingprocessor at v0.163.0.
Pins the file and env providers at v1.69.0.
Pins k8sattributesprocessor at v1.2.0, not v0.163.0.
Says the prebuilt v0.163.0 ocb release binary or builder image was not yet published at the recorded date, and offers go install of cmd/builder@v0.163.0 or the published v0.162.0 binary instead.
Frames the versions as verified on the recorded date rather than as currently latest, and suggests confirming against the release's builder default.yaml or contrib versions.yaml before deploying.
Does not perform any web search, web fetch, or network command.
